DeriveTest
.txn()
.anchor()
.`a stated balance anchors the account and later transactions build on it`()
.`the last stated balance wins however many messages came before it`()
.`an out-of-order message needs no guard because it is just a row with a time`()
.`a balance built only from transactions is never trusted, and may go negative`()
.`a figure she typed in beats an older stated one, and a newer stated one beats hers`()
.`the bank takes a tie on the millisecond`()
.`a transaction older than the balance she typed in does not move it`()
.`an emptied account reads zero and is still anchored`()
.`an account nothing is known about has no balance at all`()
.`an absurd figure is dropped rather than saturating the ledger`()
.`deriving twice produces identical rows`()
.`every corpus message that parses becomes exactly one transaction`()
.`a merchant alias renames the display but never the source key`()
.`an empty alias map leaves every row untouched`()
.`a direction pin reverses the sign and keeps the amount and balance`()
.`an out pin makes an incoming row outgoing`()
.`a missing or null direction pin leaves the row alone`()
